verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair question for a SaaS experimentation platform that ships AI features such as its AI Visual Editor, so the axis applies. The pack has no AI-training policy or opt-out control. Self-hosting and the statement that targeting attribute values are never sent to GrowthBook are related data-minimization measures. They do not establish a documented way to stop data being used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
